system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

Your Chakra magnetizes everything, allowing you to not be caught off guard and even strike from unconventional locations. Increase the number of Magnetic Charges you can have to 6.

Additionally, you can extend your radius of dominion, by entering a Magnetic Surge state as a Bonus action, which lasts for 1 minute. While in this Magnetic Surge state, you emanate a 40-foot radius of dominion, centered on you, that moves with you. You gain the following benefits for the duration. Once you exit this state, you cannot use it again until you complete a rest;

Jiton Clan Hijutsu you cast or Dust Veil abilities you use, can originate from any space you can see within your radius of dominion.

Creatures of your choice within your radius of dominion that you can see treat the area as difficult terrain.

Once per turn, when you force a creature to move against their will, you can increase the distance moved by +10 feet.

You regain 2 Magnetic Charges at the beginning of your turns, instead of 1.
